kaikki_vikisozluk.e: سِهْرِيز or سُهْرِيز • (sihrīz or suhrīz) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: A Middle Persian borrowing acquired in Baṣra. Al-Jawālīqī, in his book about Arabicized terminology, draws it to Persian سُهْر (suhr, “red”), which is now سرخ (surx, “red”). He gives two apparently Persianate synonyms سَوَادِيّ (sawādiyy) and أَوْتَكِيّ (ʔawtakiyy).
